title: USER-VLM 360°: Personalized Vision Language Models with User-aware Tuning for Social Human-Robot Interactions
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its bias mitigation focuses on demographic attributes like age, gender, and ethnicity.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as its analysis is focused on personalizing model responses based on visual demographic cues like age, gender, and ethnicity.
